description: This file defines a React functional component for a navigation bar (NavBar) in a book-related web application. It includes a subcomponent NavItem for individual navigation links with icons, utilizes Material-UI components and theming, and imports route constants for navigation.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: A React component for individual navigation items with an icon and text, wrapped in a routing Link.

methods.name: NavItem
methods.description: Component for rendering a link item in the navigation bar with an icon and text.

methods.name: NavBar
methods.description: Main component that renders the application's navigation bar with links to various sections.
